metaTitle: Govee Lights with Twitch Channel Points | ItsBagelBot
metaDesc: Let viewers control compatible Govee lights with channel points on Twitch. Connect an API key, create rewards and test colour names or hex codes.
title: Let chat change your Govee lights.
lead: Viewers control your Govee lights with channel points: they redeem a reward and type a colour. The integration is included in the free plan.
howTitle: Connect a light and test a reward.
step1Desc: In Govee Home, open Profile, then Settings, then Apply for API Key. Submit the form and check your email for the key, including your spam folder.
step2Desc: Paste the key on the dashboard’s Govee page and pick a colour-capable light from the list. The key is stored encrypted.
step3Desc: Create a channel-point reward on the Govee page. Redeem it with blue or #00ccff to test that your light turns on and changes colour.
item1Desc: 18 English colour names, including red, blue, purple, warm and gold.
item3Desc: The bot confirms the colour change in chat. Edit the reply on the Govee page.
item4Desc: Points are refunded automatically if the colour is unrecognised or the light cannot be reached.
listNote: Rewards work only while you are live by default. Turn off Live only on the Govee page to allow changes between streams.
faqA1: Use a colour-capable light listed on the Govee page after you add your API key. Choose a device from that list before creating its reward.
faqQ2: Can chat control more than one light?
faqA2: Yes. Create a reward for each light on the Govee page. Viewers choose the light by redeeming its reward.
faqQ3: What if a viewer types a colour the bot doesn't know?
faqA3: The bot refunds their points and suggests an English colour name such as blue or a hex code such as #00ccff.
faqA4: The key is stored encrypted and is not displayed after you save it. You can remove it from the Govee page at any time.
faqA5: Yes. The Govee integration is included in the free plan.
ctaTitle: Connect a light and try a colour.
tblNote: The reply line is the default and can be rewritten on the Govee page. Colour names are English words.
prereq1: A Govee API key, requested in the Govee Home app under Profile, Settings.
prereq2: A colour-capable Govee light on the same account, listed by the dashboard.
prereq3: A channel-point reward, which you create from the Govee page.
item5Desc: Pick a colour-capable light from the device list shown after you add your Govee API key.
